issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: CREEM 2.0
products.tagline: Sell and grow your AI built products
products.summaryZh: 销售并发展你的人工智能构建产品
products.descriptionZh: Creem 2.0 是 AI 构建时代的资金平台：在全球销售软件和数字产品，支付、税务、打款、联盟营销和用量计费均由平台处理。面向 AI 构建者的一体化平台，将他们构建的东西转化为业务。支付、税务、计费、联盟营销、打款，覆盖全球。打造产品从数月缩短到一个周末。但从中获得收入却没有跟上，借助 CREEM，你可以以同样的速度前进。
products.description: - Creem 2.0 is the money platform for the AI building era: sell software and digital products globally, with payments, taxes, payouts, affiliates and usage billing handled for you - The all in one platform for AI builders to turn what they build into a business. Payments, taxes, billing, affiliates, payouts, worldwide. Building a product went from months to a weekend. Getting paid for it did not, with CREEM you can move at the same speed.

products.name: Bitrise Remote Dev Environments
products.tagline: Cloud Macs your coding agents can actually build on
products.summaryZh: 云端 Mac，你的编码代理真正能构建于其上
products.descriptionZh: Bitrise RDE 为你提供数秒内即可启动的云端 Mac 和 Linux 机器，与你的 CI 使用相同的机器、技术栈和缓存。通过 MCP 为每个 agent 分配独立机器并并行运行，或接入 VS Code、Cursor 或 Claude Code。停止时归档，之后可恢复。
products.description: Bitrise RDE gives you cloud Macs & Linux machines that start in seconds, the same machines, stacks and caches as your CI. Give every agent its machine and run them in parallel via MCP, or attach VS Code, Cursor or Claude Code. Archive when you stop, restore later.

products.name: Text Agent Store
products.tagline: A marketplace for AI agents you can text
products.summaryZh: 一个可以通过短信使用的AI代理市场
products.descriptionZh: 认识所有可以发短信的智能体。Agent Store 是一个 AI 智能体目录，这些智能体存在于你手机通讯录的一个联系人中。浏览这个短信智能体生态，发一条短信即可开始使用。无需账户，无需下载，无需设置。
products.description: Meet all the agents you can text. Agent Store is a directory of AI agents that live inside a contact in your phone book. Browse an ecosystem of texting agents, and send one text to start using them today. No account, no download, no setup.

products.name: Modaal for Android
products.tagline: Ship on both stores from one project using Swift + Kotlin
products.summaryZh: 使用 Swift + Kotlin 从一个项目发布到两个商店
products.descriptionZh: Modaal for Android 让你用同一个 AI agent 将一款应用发布到两个商店，无需重新构建。Modaal 共享的是逻辑，而非屏幕，因此不必用一套 React Native 代码库在两种手机上绘制相同界面：你的 agent 从一个项目出发，为 iPhone 编写真正的 Swift/SwiftUI，为 Android 编写真正的 Kotlin 和 Jetpack Compose，而构建过程会证明两者行为一致。因此，任何用 Modaal 构建过 iPhone 应用的人，都能在不改动一行逻辑的情况下添加 Android 版本——没有 credit 计量，无需重新构建。
products.description: Modaal for Android let you ship one app to both stores with your own AI agent - no rebuild. Rather than one React Native codebase that draws the same screens on both phones, Modaal shares the logic, not the screens: your agent writes real Swift/SwiftUI for iPhone and real Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android from one project, and the build proves both behave the same. So anyone who built an iPhone app with Modaal can add Android without touching a line of logic — no credit meters, no rebuild.

products.name: NovaSynth by Noveum
products.tagline: Test your voice agent on the callers you can’t stage.
products.summaryZh: 在无法预演的来电者身上测试你的语音代理。
products.descriptionZh: 通过自定义角色、场景、打断、噪音、口音和网络条件，大规模模拟真实来电者。NovaSynth 将这些通话接入你的语音代理，从 30 多个维度对音频和转录文本进行评分，并呈现对团队至关重要的故障与修复方案。
products.description: Simulate realistic callers at scale with custom personas, scenarios, interruptions, noise, accents, and network conditions. NovaSynth runs those calls against your voice agent, scores audio and transcripts across 30+ dimensions, and surfaces the failures and fixes that matter to your team.

products.name: Higgsfield API
products.tagline: One async API for 50+ generative media models
products.summaryZh: 一个异步API，支持50多种生成式媒体模型
products.descriptionZh: Higgsfield API 是一个经过身份验证的异步 API，用于生成式媒体。通过相同的请求生命周期——提交、轮询或 webhook、下载——调用 Seedance、Kling、Soul、Grok Imagine、Wan 以及 50 多个前沿模型。在 Console 中探索模型，在 Cloud 中获取密钥，使用 Python/TypeScript SDK 进行交付。按使用量付费，热门模型可享高达 50% 的入门折扣。在 open.higgsfield.ai 构建你自己的 Higgsfield。
products.description: Higgsfield API is one authenticated, asynchronous API for generative media. Call Seedance, Kling, Soul, Grok Imagine, Wan, and 50+ frontier models through the same request lifecycle — submit, poll or webhook, download. Explore models in Console, get keys in Cloud, ship with Python/TypeScript SDKs. Pay per use with intro discounts up to 50% off your top models. Build your own Higgsfield at open.higgsfield.ai.

products.name: MCPJam
products.tagline: The testing & evaluations platform for MCP servers
products.summaryZh: MCP服务器的测试与评估平台
products.descriptionZh: 在你的 MCP 服务器上运行用户测试、Swarms、Evals 和 CI/CD 门禁，看看用户是否真的能在 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Copilot 中成功完成任务。通过桌面应用、CLI 或 SDK 测试本地服务器。
products.description: Run User Testing, Swarms, Evals, and CI/CD gates on your MCP server to see if users actually succeed in ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot. Test local servers via desktop app, CLI, or SDK.

products.name: Die With Me
products.tagline: AIM buddy list for your friends’ Claude Code and Codex usage
products.summaryZh: 用于查看朋友使用 Claude Code 和 Codex 情况的 AIM 好友列表
products.descriptionZh: 一个用于查看 AI 使用情况的 AIM 好友列表。在 Mac 上以小小吉祥物的形式查看好友的 Claude Code 和 Codex 额度。设置状态、访问他们的房间，并在额度不足时解锁聊天室。你的 AI 下班了，但朋友们还在。
products.description: An AIM buddy list for your AI usage. See friends’ Claude Code and Codex allowances as little mascots on your Mac. Set a status, visit their rooms, and unlock a chatroom when your allowance runs low. Your AI clocks out, but your friends are still here.

products.name: Figo
products.tagline: See every move your competitors make
products.summaryZh: 看清竞争对手的每一步动作
products.descriptionZh: Figo替你盯着竞争对手，你无需亲自关注。每周它会检查对手的排名、新页面、博客文章、Google Ads、Meta广告、TikTok广告、Instagram、Facebook和Reddit，还会查看当买家寻求推荐时，ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini和Perplexity给出的说法。周一早上你会收到一份简短简报：发生了什么变化、意味着什么，以及一件可以采取行动的事。添加你的网站，它会为你找到竞争对手。
products.description: Figo watches your competitors so you do not have to. Every week it checks their rankings, new pages, blog posts, Google Ads, Meta ads, TikTok ads, Instagram, Facebook and Reddit, plus what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity say when buyers ask for a recommendation. Monday morning you get a short briefing: what changed, what it means, and one thing to do about it. Add your website and it finds the competitors for you.

products.name: Zella
products.tagline: Video recorder that edits itself on Mac and iPhone
products.summaryZh: 在Mac和iPhone上自动编辑的视频录像机
products.descriptionZh: Zella 可在你的 Mac 或 iPhone 上录制屏幕或摄像头，并为你剪辑视频。无需上传，无需账户，无订阅。免费支持 1080p，无水印。一键运行 Auto-Polish：添加字幕、剪除静音、去除填充词、自动缩放，并优化人声。Make it Viral 可添加节奏、转场、音效和背景音乐。Pro 版一次性支付 89 美元，永久解锁 Mac 和 iPhone 双端，无需按月付费。
products.description: Zella records your screen or camera and edits the video for you, on your own Mac or iPhone. Nothing uploads, no account, no subscription. Free at 1080p with no watermark. One tap runs Auto-Polish: captions, silence cuts, filler words removed, zoom-ins and a cleaned-up voice. Make it Viral adds pacing, transitions, sound effects and a music bed. Pro is one payment of $89 that unlocks Mac and iPhone together, for life, instead of a monthly bill.

products.name: Pitchfire for Startups
products.tagline: Reach investors that are aligned with you
products.summaryZh: 触达与你志同道合的投资者
products.descriptionZh: Pitchfire for Startups 是一个触达投资人的新渠道。上传你的路演材料，通过我们的 AI 匹配风投，让 Pitchfire 用一封邮件介绍为你的初创公司造势。Pitchfire 将投资人与初创公司连接在一起。过去一年，我们为风投机构打造了 AI 助理，如今正将这项技术反向用于为初创公司匹配风投。注册即可每天获得与三位投资人的匹配和介绍。上传你的投资人名单，如果我们有他们的联系方式，就会为你引荐。
products.description: Pitchfire for Startups is a new channel to reach investors. Upload your pitch deck, get matched to VCs with our AI, and let Pitchfire hype your startup with an email intro. Pitchfire brings investors and startups togethr. Over the past year, we've built AI associates for VC firms, and are now inverting the tech to match startups up with VCs. Sign up to get matched and intro'd to three investors a day. Upload your investor lists and we'll intro you if we have their contact data.

products.name: Blanc
products.tagline: A minimal browser with a floating island for a toolbar
products.summaryZh: 一个极简浏览器，工具栏采用悬浮岛设计
products.descriptionZh: Blanc 是一款适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的免费桌面浏览器。其悬浮岛取代了标签栏和工具栏，而广告和追踪器拦截在网络层运行。可选的 Patron 增加了命名工作区。
products.description: Blanc is a free desktop browser for macOS, Windows and Linux. Its floating Island replaces the tab strip and toolbar, while ad and tracker blocking runs at the network layer. Optional Patron adds Named Workspaces.

products.name: Axiom
products.tagline: The modern machine data platform
products.summaryZh: 现代机器数据平台
products.descriptionZh: 现代机器数据平台——在完全托管的事件存储上实现PB级、无模式的数据摄取，让你保留每一个字节，而无需承担自行运维的成本。
products.description: The modern machine data platform — Petabyte-scale, schema-less ingest on a fully managed event store, so you keep every byte without the operational cost of running it yourself.

products.name: MacSentinel
products.tagline: Find what’s slowing your Mac then clean it safely
products.summaryZh: 找出拖慢 Mac 速度的原因，然后安全清理。
products.descriptionZh: MacSentinel 将 Mac 监控、诊断、存储分析和清理整合到一个原生工作流中。它不只是显示系统指标或删除通用缓存，而是在本地解释变慢的可能原因，然后帮助你安全地采取行动。Smart Care 包含 50 个类别下的 500 多条应用规则，覆盖开发者、创意、生产力和 AI 工具。清理以废纸篓优先且可恢复，Pro 为一次性购买——无需订阅。
products.description: MacSentinel brings Mac monitoring, diagnosis, storage analysis, and cleanup into one native workflow. Instead of simply showing system metrics or deleting generic caches, it explains likely causes of slowdowns locally, then helps you act safely. Smart Care includes 500+ app rules across 50 categories, covering developer, creative, productivity, and AI tools. Cleanup is Trash-first and recoverable, and Pro is a one-time purchase — no subscription.

products.name: AskDeck
products.tagline: Call an AI to get a PowerPoint and a narrated video back
products.summaryZh: 呼叫 AI，即可获得一份 PowerPoint 和一段带旁白的视频
products.descriptionZh: 其他AI演示工具都要求你坐在笔记本电脑前输入提示词。这个工具可以直接呼叫。通过电话、短信、邮件或网页向Eric下达简报，也可以在Claude、ChatGPT或Cursor内通过MCP操作。返回的是一份可编辑的PowerPoint（pptx）以及一段讲解该演示的视频。免费带水印预览：无需账号，无需银行卡。29美元一次性付费获取正式文件，永久归你所有，无需订阅。已有半成品演示？上传后Eric会帮你完成——润色、换成你的品牌风格，或继续搭建。
products.description: Every other AI deck tool makes you sit at a laptop and type a prompt. This one you can call. Brief Eric by phone, SMS, email or web — or from inside Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor via MCP. An editable PowerPoint (pptx) and a narrated video that presents it come back. Free watermarked preview: no account, no card. $29 once for the real file, yours to keep, no subscription required. Have a half-done deck? Upload it and Eric finishes it — polish, reskin to your brand, or build it out.

products.name: The Forge by Bob's Workshop
products.tagline: Describe your idea & your team builds, deploys & operates it
products.summaryZh: 描述你的想法，你的团队负责构建、部署和运营。
products.descriptionZh: The Forge为你提供完整的开发、销售和营销团队。用通俗语言描述你想构建的东西。他们负责规划、设计、构建和部署。无需编写代码。每个应用都自带生产级数据库和认证系统、AI模型选项、支付集成、内置CRM、品牌管理以及自主维护。与Lovable、Bolt或Replit不同——The Forge不只是生成代码。它运营你的产品并构建你的业务。
products.description: The Forge gives you an entire development, sales, and marketing team. Describe what you want to build in plain language. They plan it, design it, build it, and deploy it. No code required. Every app ships with a production quality database and auth system, ai model options, payment integration, built-in CRM, brand management, and autonomous maintenance. Unlike Lovable, Bolt, or Replit — The Forge doesn't just generate code. It operates your product and builds your business.

products.name: Opyt
products.tagline: Your attention is the context your AI is missing
products.summaryZh: 你的注意力，正是你的AI所缺失的上下文。
products.descriptionZh: Opyt 把你已经关注的人和话题变成一个知识库。指向你的 X 书签、Substack 订阅、博客、GitHub 仓库或 arXiv 论文，它就会拉取它们的存档。它会通读一个主题，写下自己的后续问题，并持续寻找在你已收集内容基础上展开的新研究。分享你的知识库，继续探索，让你的 AI 阅读全部内容。免费，MIT 许可，你的知识库可以保持本地。
products.description: Opyt turns the people and topics you already follow into a knowledge base. Point it at your X bookmarks, Substack subscriptions, blogs, GitHub repos or arXiv papers, and it pulls in their archives. It reads a topic through, writes its own follow-up questions, and keeps looking for new work that builds on what you've collected. Share what your knowledge base, keep exploring, and let your AI read it all. Free, MIT licensed, and your knowledge base can stay local.

products.name: Compute:Arena
products.tagline: Community submitted benchmarks for Local AI
products.summaryZh: 社区提交的本地AI基准测试
products.descriptionZh: 社区提交的本地AI模型性能基准测试，适用于任何硬件、任何运行时、任何量化。
products.description: Community-submitted performance benchmarks for local AI models on any hardware, any runtime, any quantisation.

products.name: QAgent
products.tagline: Automated QA for AI agents. Stop shipping on vibes.
products.summaryZh: AI代理的自动化质量保证。别再凭感觉发布了。
products.descriptionZh: 自动化 AI 智能体质量测试。在不良响应触达真实客户之前，对正确性进行评分、依据基准事实检测幻觉、验证策略遵循情况，并对 RAG 进行基准测试。
products.description: Automate AI agent quality testing. Score correctness, detect hallucinations against ground truth, verify policy adherence, and benchmark RAG before bad responses reach real customers.

products.name: TinyKPI
products.tagline: Your business analytics directly in your notch
products.summaryZh: 你的业务分析直接显示在灵动岛上
products.descriptionZh: 连接你已在使用的工具，从 Stripe 和 PostHog 到 Google Analytics 以及你自己的数据库。挑选你关心的 KPI，按你的方式排列，并让它们实时显示在一个围绕 MacBook 刘海打造的小巧、可自定义仪表盘中。100% 本地。你的数据永远不会离开你的 Mac。
products.description: Connect the tools you already usefrom Stripe and PostHog to Google Analytics and your own database. Pick the KPIs you care about, arrange them your way, and keep them live in a tiny, customizable dashboard built around your MacBook notch. 100% local. Your data never leaves your Mac.
